critical_code_review_comments: member_routes.claim_recruitment_purchase branches only on offer_source+tier. The direct_board_recruitment_project branch has no tier check, which is fine, but consider validating session.amount_total==199700 defensively to prevent future price-lookup drift from silently granting entitlement.

payment_routes.create_direct_project_checkout is a fully public unauthenticated endpoint with no rate limit; combined with resolve_direct_project_price_id() dynamic Stripe.Product.create fallback (env var missing path), this could be abused to spam Stripe products in test/dev. In production the env price ID is set so it is safe, but adding basic rate limiting or reCAPTCHA on public checkout endpoints (diy-checkout, direct-project-checkout) is recommended.

PurchaseSuccessPage.jsx submit() sets busy=false only inside the catch block; on the happy path busy stays true until navigation, which is intentional but if navigation ever fails silently the button becomes permanently disabled. Consider a finally clause resetting busy on navigation timeout.
